parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

instancePort.description: The port on which the instance server is listening - 25, 80, 443, 465, 587, or 1024-65535.

instanceProtocol.description: The protocol to use for routing traffic to back-end instances: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, or SSL.

loadBalancerPort.description: The port on which the load balancer is listening: 25, 80, 443, 465, 587, or 1024-65535.

protocol.description: The load balancer transport protocol to use for routing: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, or SSL.

sSLCertificateId.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the server certificate. This is required for HTTPS
